documents.title: Newton County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 48 pages. Amounts are the Section 5 'Maximum Appropriated Amounts' on each handwritten ordinance form (the only amounts); cross-checked against the typed summary ordinances on pp. 47-48 column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
